replies.author: Coco_stag
replies.body:
Alright, here's my honest opinion.
The map itself looks pretty dull; nothing too special about it. 

Firstly, the amount of trees is just overload. I know you are trying to give the map the taste of that theme, but it is just too much. Remove some of the trees, so its almost like a parkour, jump-to-jump tree thing, I don't know.

Secondly, the ground is very bumpy. There is leaves stacked every where and if you were to sprint/run over it. You would probably fall in a hole every 2 seconds. Again, very hard to walk on.

Thirdly, the bridge. It looks quite dull, and not pleasing to the eye. Add more block pallet to the bridge, and make sure its creative.

Lastly, the block pallet (generalised to the whole map). The main blocks I see is leaves and wood. Add more pallet to it, so it looks unique and not so plain.

Goodluck!

replies.author: Petlas
replies.body: This probably isn't the best choice of terrain for a Nebula map, honestly. The gameplay would be annoying and unfair; Players would complain about having to weave between all the trees and bushes, and if a certain amount of people get on top of the trees they can easily spawnkill and have an unfair advantage in general. Sorry to burst your bubble.
